# Living Brain

> Living Brain (livingbrain.wiki) is a teammate in your Slack that builds and keeps its own company wiki in plain Markdown. A Factory Zero venture. Status: early access, in design. Not built yet.

## What it does
- Remembers: turns conversations in invited channels into Markdown pages for people, projects, decisions and customers. Every fact links to its source message.
- Evolves: on a schedule it merges duplicates, flags contradictions, retires stale facts and rewrites summaries. It learns how each person works.
- Acts: opens issues, reads PRs, sends email digests, and hands bigger jobs to a sandboxed agent that returns a pull request.
- Coding agents: connects to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode or any MCP agent. Agents get team context before writing code; with opt-in, agent decisions become wiki pages (secrets redacted).
- Works with Colonizer (colonizer.dev): launches isolated microVM colonies that return pull requests and report learnings back to the wiki.
- You own it: plain Markdown, exportable, opens in Obsidian.
- Private by design: reads only with the asker's own Slack access.
- Bring your own model: Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- Built in Rust on Cloudflare's edge.

## Planned pricing (per workspace)
- Free: $0, up to 5 people
- Bring your own model: $5/mo, unlimited people
- Crew: $9/mo, model included, up to 25 people
